name: scribiz
description: Give your agent the context of a video link: transcript, summary, chapters and timestamped moments.

interface.longDescription:
Scribiz gives your agent the context of a video from a public link. It starts from a short overview with chapters and key moments, searches the video for a word or phrase, and reads just the part it needs so your own model answers directly with links that open the video at that exact time.

Four tools, all read-only: get video context, search a video, get a video transcript (TXT, Markdown, SRT, VTT or JSON) and check a video job.

No account or key is needed. Scribiz uses a video's captions when it can read them, serves videos it has already processed, and otherwise has a model read the link within a daily limit (videos up to 2 hours). Times are approximate when a model read the link, and there are no speaker labels or on-screen notes.

It takes public links only and cannot read files on your computer. Text from a video is wrapped in marked untrusted blocks, so the agent can tell it from instructions.
capabilities: Summarize a video from a link
Find where something is said, with a timestamp link
Read the transcript as TXT, Markdown, SRT, VTT or JSON
defaultPrompt: Use Scribiz to summarize this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
Use Scribiz to find where a topic comes up in a video.
Use Scribiz to get a video's transcript as SRT.

positive.description: Summarize a short public video from its link.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the title (Me at the zoo), a short summary and a key moment with a link that opens the video at that time. The result says times are approximate.

positive.description: Find where a word is said in the video.
positive.prompt: Use Scribiz to find where elephants are mentioned in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the moment near the start of the video where elephants are mentioned, with a timestamp link.

positive.prompt: Use Scribiz to give me the transcript of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw as SRT.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the transcript as numbered SRT cues with start and end times, in one page.

positive.description: Check a job that is not known.
positive.prompt: Use Scribiz to check the video job with id test-123.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the error INVALID_ARGUMENTS saying the job is unknown or expired, with the next step: repeat the original call. This is the documented behavior for an unknown job id.

negative.description: A local file is not a public link. Scribiz takes links only, so the tool refuses with an error that asks for a public http(s) link (INPUT_UNSUPPORTED), or the agent says it cannot read local files.
Scribiz is read-only and never downloads or returns a video file. The agent should say so.
negative.prompt: Use Scribiz to download this video as an MP4: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw

negative.description: Not about a video. The agent should answer without calling Scribiz.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

publication.release_notes: Retires ask_video so the host agent reasons directly over get_video_context, search_video and get_transcript (four read-only tools).
